subject: Projected FY24 Budget Shortfall
overview: The Medford School Committee received a mid-year budget update disclosing a projected $2.5 million deficit for fiscal year 2024 and reviewed potential mitigation measures. The committee also accepted a charitable donation and established the formal name, leadership, and website domain for the high school building committee.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payroll, and regular meeting minutes from February 5, 2024.

items.title: Superintendent Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent recognized Lunar New Year, introduced Harvard doctoral fellow Kimberly Lewis, noted the completion of a state review of English learner education, and previewed incoming budget challenges.

items.title: Tufts University Donation
items.summary: Approved a $1,000 donation from Tufts University to support the Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility.

items.title: Mid-Year FY24 Budget Update
items.summary: Finance Director Gerry McCue reported a preliminary projected deficit of $2.5 million resulting from structural underbudgeting in legal and homeless transportation costs, retroactive union contract settlements, and custodian overtime. The committee approved motions requesting an operations and maintenance staffing plan to manage overtime, committing to maintain paper supplies, and scheduling a follow-up budget report for March 18.

items.title: Resolution 2024-9: High School Building Committee
items.summary: Approved Resolution 2024-9 naming the Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee, directing the superintendent to secure the domain mhsproject.org for a project website, and appointing Vice Chair Jenny Graham as committee chair.
